issues.detail: The Greek 'ου γαρ εκρινα του ειδεναι' means 'for I have decided NOT to know' (negative). The Vietnamese translation says 'quyết định không biết điều gì khác' (decided not to know anything else), which adds a contrast ('khác' - other/else) that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek simply states the decision not to know anything regarding them except for Christ.
